note: Fixed rules: weekly rebalance, eligible = close > 200-SMA and 126-day return > 0, top 8 by momentum, keep while inside rank 16, equal notional, whole shares, 4 bps slippage and 3 bps/month roll cost. Market gate: the book only invests while NIFTY itself is above its 200-day average, otherwise it holds cash. Parameters were fixed before running; the gate was added after crisis-window analysis and is reported both with and without for transparency.
